# EM Law

> > Band 1 Chambers-ranked commercial law firm in Central London providing specialist legal services to SMEs across corporate, property, technology, and dispute resolution.

EM Law is a London-based law firm offering comprehensive commercial legal services with particular expertise in corporate transactions, commercial property, technology and AI law, construction, employment, and dispute resolution. The firm serves clients ranging from SMEs to FTSE 100 companies and international development organizations.

## Key Topics

- Commercial Law
- Corporate Transactions
- Commercial Property
- Technology & AI Law
- Construction Law
- Employment Law
- Data Protection & GDPR
- Dispute Resolution
- Commercial Contracts
- International Commercial Law
- Media & Entertainment Law
- UK GDPR Compliance
- JCT & NEC Contracts
- M&A & Due Diligence
- SaaS & Software Licensing

## Core Practice Areas

- [Practice Areas Overview](https://emlaw.co.uk/practice-areas): Overview of EM Law's practice areas including corporate, employment, construction
- [Corporate Solicitors](https://emlaw.co.uk/corporate-law-firm): Corporate solicitors for M&A, share purchases, and due diligence
- [Commercial Contract Lawyers](https://emlaw.co.uk/contract-law-firm): Commercial agreement and contract lawyers for business agreements
- [Technology & Software Lawyers](https://emlaw.co.uk/software-technology-lawyers): Technology lawyers for SaaS, software licensing, and outsourcing contracts
- [AI & Tech Lawyers](https://emlaw.co.uk/ai-lawyers): AI and tech lawyers specializing in EU AI Act and GDPR compliance
- [Employment Law](https://emlaw.co.uk/employment-law-firm): Employment law solicitors for contracts, TUPE, and tribunal work
- [Dispute Resolution](https://emlaw.co.uk/dispute-resolution-solicitors): Litigation and dispute resolution for commercial and professional disputes

## Commercial Property & Real Estate

- [Commercial Property Solicitors](https://emlaw.co.uk/commercial-property-law): Band 1 commercial property solicitors for leases and transactions
- [Commercial Leases](https://emlaw.co.uk/commercial-property-law/commercial-leases-solicitors): Commercial lease negotiation and drafting under Landlord and Tenant Act 1954
- [Commercial Property Financing](https://emlaw.co.uk/commercial-property-law/commercial-property-financing-solicitors): Real estate finance and loan documentation for property investment
- [Commercial Property Licences](https://emlaw.co.uk/commercial-property-law/licences-solicitors): Guidance on commercial property licences vs leases and occupancy rights
- [Easements](https://emlaw.co.uk/commercial-property-law/easements-solicitors): Legal guidance on easements under LPA 1925 for property solicitors
- [Positive Covenants](https://emlaw.co.uk/commercial-property-law/positive-covenants-solicitors): Positive covenants and covenant enforcement under LPA 1925 section 78

## Specialized Legal Services

- [Construction Lawyers](https://emlaw.co.uk/construction-lawyers-2): Construction lawyers specializing in JCT and NEC contract negotiation

- [International Commercial Lawyers](https://emlaw.co.uk/international-commercial-lawyers): International commercial law for cross-border contracts and transactions
